summary.text: Mike Stein is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Rush Bricken.
Stein advanced from the Democratic primary on August 6, 2026, with 1,664 votes and no opponent on the ballot.
